name: NotuBiz council portals
notes: Council information sites for 100+ Dutch municipalities, including Den Bosch, Breda and Eindhoven. Portals sit behind a bot check, so the tracker cannot confirm their state.

name: NCSC (Dutch national cyber security centre)
notes: Shows "Onze website is tijdelijk niet beschikbaar" (our website is temporarily unavailable).

name: Valtori (Finnish central government web services)
notes: Valtori is shutting down public-facing central government web services as a precaution. It says this is not the result of an attack.

name: University of Vienna
notes: The home page is a notice: potentially vulnerable IT systems were taken offline as a precaution because of the PHP flaws ("Präventive Abschaltung zentraler IT-Services"). Websites, webmail and Moodle reported off.

name: University of Freiburg
notes: The home page shows a computing centre notice about the PHP vulnerabilities.

name: Haaga-Helia University of Applied Sciences
notes: A banner says the site is shut down today for a critical security update, along with Moodle, the study guide and other services. It says services return by Thursday at the latest.

name: Tweakers
notes: Blocks automated checks. State not confirmed.
